value: To what extent do executive functions contribute to factual knowledge, procedural skill and conceptual understanding, do these domain-specific components mediate the executive-function-to-mathematics-achievement relationship, and does this change with age?

Using regression, mediation and variance-partitioning analyses on a 293-person 8-to-25-year-old sample, the paper shows that working memory reaches mathematics achievement both directly and indirectly via factual knowledge, procedural skill and (verbally only) conceptual understanding, with the pattern stable across age.
